name: Wild banana-flower salad
summary: A salad of wild banana flower on the Thai table in the valley. The flower itself is sold at Phố Đoàn market.
origin: The Thai table, Pù Luông. Sources: VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023; The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 26 Sep 2026.
howToEat: As a salad with the Thai meal.
where: The Thai meal in the valley. The flower is at Phố Đoàn on Thursday and Sunday.
seoTitle: Wild banana-flower salad in Pu Luong
seoDescription: Nộm hoa chuối rừng is a Thai salad of wild banana flower. The flower is sold at Phố Đoàn.
